profile.name: Elveflow OB1‑Mk4 微流控压力控制器
profile.description: 这是一款用于微流控实验的多通道压力控制器，可为芯片、储液器或流体回路提供精密气压驱动。设备可读取各压力通道数据，并可接入流量或压力传感器进行监测、校准与闭环 PID 控制，常用于稳定微流量输送、液滴生成和微流控芯片流路调节。
profile.description_en: This device is a multi-channel pressure controller for microfluidic experiments, providing precise pneumatic actuation for chips, reservoirs, and fluidic circuits. It can read pressure on each channel and work with flow or pressure sensors for monitoring, calibration, and closed-loop PID control, making it suitable for stable low-flow delivery, droplet generation, and microfluidic flow regulation.
